algorithm.title: Affinity Algorithm
algorithm.subtitle: How we calculate ideological matching
algorithm.indifference_desc: Indifference defines flexibility. If both users are indifferent, affinity is total (100%). If only one is, a partial score of 51% applies.
algorithm.quadratic_desc: Based on range overlap. If there is contact (Overlap), it scales from 50 to 100. If there is separation (Gap), it decays from 50 to 0 quadratically.
algorithm.modifiers_desc: Conditioners adjust the base level score. Match (+5), Indifference (+2.5), or Divergence (-5). Limits of +15 / -20.
algorithm.aggregation_desc: Calculation ascends from individual axes to total affinity.
